style: Original PLAYER HERO design for a polished STYLIZED 3D first-person roguelite shooter, matching the hero art of Gunfire Reborn. Strongly stylized, not realistic: heroic chibi-leaning proportions about 4.5 heads tall (big expressive animal head, oversized hands and boots, compact sturdy body), bold readable silhouette, smooth sculpted forms with clean bevelled edges, fur as a few large carved clumps (never individual strands), clothing as thick simple folds, flat-ish hand-painted textures with soft gradients and restrained edge wear, two or three dominant colour blocks plus one glowing spirit-fire accent. Likeable, confident, a little cheeky: this is the character the player chooses. No photorealistic fur, skin, anatomy detail, realistic fabric or semi-realistic painting. Distinctly Chinese mythological fantasy mixed with adventurer gear (holsters, belts, pouches).

chapters.heroes: The heroes are wandering spirit-fire wardens (灵火守望者) who carry guns powered by spirit fire through the Red Sand Silk Road, the Kunlun Snow Ruins and Zhurong's Fire Hell. Their species, silhouettes and palettes must stay clearly apart from the enemy roster (jerboa, scorpion archer, toad, apsara, fire rat, lion-like tomb beast, white nine-tailed fox witch, blue bird, ape, black tortoise).

layouts.hero: Output: one character design sheet on a plain flat light grey background (#D6D6D6), no text, labels or frames. Left half: a large three-quarter view in a confident action pose with {weapon}. Right half, side by side at the same scale: a FRONT view and a BACK view standing in a relaxed A-pose with empty open hands, full body head to feet. Bottom right: two small close-ups, one open hand (thumb plus four separate fingers, clearly countable) and one foot or boot. Even studio lighting, no cast shadows.

designs.name: 燎 (red panda fire gunslinger)
designs.role: 火系输出：燃爆雷 / 九尾狐火→爆竹火团 / 余烬
designs.brief: An agile anthropomorphic RED PANDA gunslinger and firework grenadier. Round head with small rounded ears with white rims, white cheek and eyebrow markings and tear-stripes, bright amber eyes, a cheeky grin. Rust-red fur on head and back, black legs and arms, a huge bushy tail with bold cream and rust rings. Wears a short dark-charcoal Song-dynasty martial jacket with a high collar and ember-orange lining, the right sleeve rolled up, a cinnabar sash, wrapped black trousers and sturdy short boots. A diagonal bandolier of red Chinese firecracker grenades (爆竹手雷) with gold paper caps across the chest, a small brass fire-starter lantern (火折子) on the hip glowing with orange-gold spirit fire. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four separate fingers.
designs.weapon: a chunky stylized lever rifle with brass fittings held in one hand while the other hand flicks a lit firecracker grenade, three small orange spirit-fire wisps circling the tail
designs.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing A-pose for rigging: arms held about 40 degrees away from the body with straight elbows, both hands open, flat and EMPTY (no gun, no grenade, no weapons anywhere), legs straight and slightly apart, mouth closed, calm expression
designs.turnaround_pose: , the firecracker bandolier and the small brass lantern on the hip worn as on the sheet (lantern glowing softly, no flames or wisps outside it), the big ringed tail extending straight backwards and slightly down behind the body, fully shown in the side views
designs.turnaround_digits: each hand open with a separate thumb and four separate slightly spread fingers (fingerless gloves), both boots complete.

designs.name: 磐 (giant pangolin craftsman warrior monk)
designs.role: 坦克：裂地重击（大尾砸地）/ 磐石壁垒（鳞甲张开）/ 厚皮
designs.brief: A big, round, huggable anthropomorphic Chinese PANGOLIN (穿山甲) craftsman warrior monk, the tank of the team, drawn in exactly the same cute-heroic chibi-leaning style as the reference heroes: a BIG head (about a quarter of the body height) with large expressive amber eyes with bright highlights, thick friendly brows, a short rounded snout and a confident cheeky grin; a barrel-shaped body much wider than the other heroes, short thick arms and legs, oversized hands and boots. Natural armour: a FEW big, simple, chunky overlapping scales (large carved plates, not dozens of small ones) cover the top of the head like a helmet crest, the back, the outer forearms and the long broad tail, warm bronze-olive with clean gold edges; only a thin line of amber spirit fire glows in a few seams. Pale cream face and belly. Fully clothed, no bare chest: a padded saffron-orange monk jacket with a high crossed collar, a deep teal sash, a short leather craftsman apron with a chisel and a small brass plumb bob, baggy dark trousers wrapped at the shins, chunky straw-and-leather boots. Big hands with FIVE digits each: a clearly separate opposable thumb on the inner side plus four separate thick fingers, five short blunt claws per hand.
designs.weapon: a chunky bronze drill-cannon shotgun resting on his shoulder in one hand, the other fist punching the ground with a small burst of amber cracks and pebbles
designs.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing A-pose for rigging: arms held about 40 degrees away from the body with straight elbows, both hands open, flat and EMPTY (no gun, no grenade, no weapons anywhere), legs straight and slightly apart, mouth closed, calm expression
designs.turnaround_pose: , with EXACTLY the proportions of the sheet: a very wide round barrel-shaped body (torso about as wide as it is tall), a BIG head about a quarter of the total height, short stubby thick legs, thick short arms with oversized hands, big chunky boots; never slimmer or taller than the sheet. Back scales lying flat and closed with the amber seams glowing softly (no sparks or effects), the long broad scaled tail extending straight backwards and slightly down behind the body with its tip just above the ground, fully shown in the side views
designs.turnaround_digits: each hand open with a separate thumb and four separate slightly spread thick fingers ending in short blunt claws, both sandal boots complete.
designs.style_note: The hand close-up must show the palm with the thumb sticking out to the side, clearly apart from the four fingers: count five claws.

designs.name: 鼯 (giant flying squirrel thunder scout)
designs.role: 雷系机动：雷暴信标 / 鹰眼·裁决→雷目 / 凌空（二段跳 + 滑翔）
designs.brief: A nimble anthropomorphic Chinese GIANT FLYING SQUIRREL (鼯鼠) thunder scout and Mohist gadgeteer. Big dark glossy eyes with a white eye ring, short rounded ears, a short muzzle, chestnut-brown fur with a cream belly and face, a long flat fluffy tail. A furred gliding membrane runs from each WRIST down to each ANKLE (never between the fingers), shown as a soft drape like a short cape along the flanks. Wears a leather aviator cap with brass goggles pushed up, an indigo Mohist (墨家) tunic with a utility harness, copper-coil wrist gadgets, and a small thunder-drum (雷鼓) beacon clipped to the belt glowing electric cyan-violet. Soft leather boots. Hands with a clearly separate thumb and four separate fingers, completely free of the membrane.
designs.weapon: a long slim bronze rail rifle with copper coils crackling with cyan-violet lightning, mid-glide with the membranes spread wide
designs.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing A-pose for rigging: arms held about 40 degrees away from the body with straight elbows, both hands open, flat and EMPTY (no gun, no grenade, no weapons anywhere), legs straight and slightly apart, mouth closed, calm expression
designs.turnaround_pose: , goggles pushed up on the aviator cap, the thunder drum on the belt glowing softly (no lightning arcs), the furred gliding membranes hanging relaxed from each wrist down to each ankle along the flanks, the long flat fluffy tail extending straight backwards and slightly down behind the body, fully shown in the side views
designs.turnaround_digits: each hand open with a separate thumb and four separate slightly spread fingers, completely free of the membrane, both boots complete.

designs.name: 磐 curled-up scale ball (entrance form)
designs.role: 磐出场演出的鳞球形态，单独模型，砸地后切换成本体
designs.turnaround_lead: the pangolin hero from the sheet completely CURLED UP like a real rolled-up pangolin into a ROUND BALL: as wide as it is tall (a sphere about 1.15 m across, never an egg, pine cone or artichoke shape). The back scales cover the whole ball as on his back (same few big chunky bronze-olive scales with gold edges and the same dark tones as the sheet, thin glowing amber seams). His long broad scaled TAIL wraps once around the outside of the ball like a thick armoured belt running from the bottom up over the front, its tip tucked over the top, clearly readable as a tail; the top of his scaled head crest shows just under the tail tip. No face, arms, legs, clothes, gun or apron visible
designs.turnaround_pose: ; the ball rests on its bottom on the ground. The tail belt must appear consistently in all four views (front: the tail runs vertically up the middle; side views: the tail curves over the front half; back: smooth back scales)
designs.turnaround_digits: No hands, feet or face visible anywhere.
